notes: Tunables for tools/sweep/sweep.py (the SWEEP THE REPO BEFORE BUILDING guard). exempt_globs: paths that never need a Sweep: trailer (docs, tests, data) -- fnmatch, where * also crosses '/'. generic_*: names too common to compare by similarity (an exact same-path hit is still reported). similarity is a difflib ratio on lower-cased, separator-free names; token_overlap is a Jaccard over CamelCase/snake tokens and only counts with 2+ shared tokens. Raise either to cut noise, lower to catch more.
